report.summary: A port scan attack was detected targeting Institution_C, originating from IP address 172.16.0.1. The attack is likely reconnaissance, aiming to identify vulnerable systems for future exploitation.
report.impact: Port scanning is reconnaissance: the attacker maps open ports and services to find vulnerable systems before a later attack. It rarely causes damage by itself but usually precedes exploitation or brute force.
response_steps: Review which ports the scan reached
Watch the same source for follow-up attacks for 24 hours

technique_details.name: Network Service Discovery
technique_details.description: Adversaries may attempt to get a listing of services running on remote hosts and local network infrastructure devices, including those that may be vulnerable to remote software exploitation.
technique_details.mitigations: Disable or Remove Feature or Program (M1042), Network Intrusion Prevention (M1031), Network Segmentation (M1030)

technique_details.name: Scanning IP Blocks
technique_details.description: Adversaries may scan victim IP blocks to gather information that can be used during targeting.
